sections.title: Introduction to Housing, Community and Economic Development
sections.description: Introduction to the theories, institutions, and practices of housing, community and economic development with a focus on improving opportunity and building wealth in disadvantaged communities. Provides foundation for advanced courses in housing policy, downtown and neighborhood revitalization, real estate and economic development finance, and local and international community development.
